description: WSJ-like news writing for reports. Use when writing or editing the prose of a report, briefing, figure caption, executive summary or research summary so it reads like disciplined business news reporting: what happened first, a nut graf saying why it matters now, evidence alternating with counter-evidence, exact numbers with unit, period and base, every claim attributed, no hype, no courtesy titles. Also use to edit an existing draft without adding facts.
